descriptor.name: Orlando Orange County assessment parcel polygons
descriptor.scope: Six distinct Orange County assessment parcel polygons passed bounded public adapter qualification around the unchanged Orlando WUP settlement locator. Thirteen 0.001-degree cells contain the same large point-containing parcel; its complete footprint discovers six distinct parcels. All six native PARCEL strings passed fresh independent reads, forced one-feature pages and matching full geometry hashes. Exact-point containment, explicit absence and one-parcel proposal binding passed. Independent root EPSG:26917 full-polygon GEOS audit found no invalidity, duplicate geometry, overlap above 0.01 m² or operation errors. Assessment parcel references are not legal title; bounded evidence does not establish citywide completeness, survey accuracy or currentness.

evidence: First-party Orange County Property Appraiser parcel metadata identifies polygons representing tax parcels in Orange County, Florida, produced for ad valorem property assessment: https://ocpaimages.ocpafl.org/api/Content/GetContentDynamicFile?contentFileID=405230 . Assessment references do not establish legal title or survey accuracy.

Frozen packet and review bind Buenaventura Lakes code 7367 to layer 4 and native PARCEL 292435606300006 through bounded spatial and independent native-ID reads at the unchanged locator. Official layer schema identifies polygon geometry, string PARCEL length 15, OBJECTID, and EPSG:2236 extent; current same-object reads verify the packet parcel. Scope is only the frozen locator and bounded qualification cells, not the municipal boundary or citywide completeness.
